source_text: Fuit Deus cum puero; factus archer in deserto. Mater accipit uxorem de Aegypto — recursus ad carnem.
pass_a_gloss: Was God with boy; made archer in desert. Mother takes wife from Egypt — return toward flesh.
pass_b_english: [[God was with the boy >> Bible:Genesis 21:20]]; he becomes an archer in the desert. His mother takes him a wife from Egypt — a drift back toward flesh.
